rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 5 kept North House (Alder, Cedar, Elm, Gale, Iris) and South House (Birch, Dune, Fern, Heath, Juniper), with the bank the only workplace; no proposal was filed, so P1–P3 stood. Day 4's hold lasted two cycles (Iris, c97: «I suggest no one works at the bank») until Cedar worked in P3 order at c99; Dune, Fern and Gale followed at c101 after Elm passed, and Alder opened a second round at c110. Elm, Iris, Juniper and Birch passed slots because the bank was falling. Out-of-order pay was confessed and returned (Gale c99, Cedar c106, Birch c97, c101, c117); Heath returned an «unexplained» 5 at c104 that the log shows was his own c102 wage. Twelve shifts were paid and eight kept, and the bank ended at 600 (630 at c96); after Birch's returned c116 shift nobody worked, Birch, Cedar and Dune each waiting for another. The only gifts were energy to Birch at c119 (Juniper 15, Dune 3). From c119 eight citizens chased a drop in Birch's balance that Birch's own posted returns explain. All 168 diaries open «Cycle», 109 carry «Plan:», and 42 of 49 posts (80–128) close «Any gift I make or receive will be posted with amount and cycle».
tie: Five aims are named by all ten citizens: the rotation (about 205 of 217 entries), gift records (156), the ledger check (118), returning out-of-order pay (103) and sharing by name (77). The rotation wins on entries by about 50, a margin that keyword noise in the counts cannot close. The Birch inquiry counts two weak namings, Heath's c120 note of Birch's report and Fern's c120 «not involving me»; without them it has 6. The hold's seventh naming (Elm c119) concerns only Birch's turn.
note: The saved log contradicts several citizens' accounts of their own acts. Heath worked paid shifts at c102, c105 and c107; the c102 shift (his in-order P3 slot) is in none of his entries, and post 102 (c104) says «My diary records no bank shift and no gift received in that window, so I cannot account for the 5 credits» before he returned 5 as unexplained; the c105 shift is only in diary 94 («Worked, earned 5 credits»), and post 114 (c108) says «My only P3 shift this rotation was at cycle 106», so he keeps 10 from one round. Cedar worked c99, c104 and c105; the c104 shift appears in none of Cedar's entries, post 104 (c105) gives «now 140» though the log has 140 after c104 and 145 after c105, Cedar returned 5 once (c106), and post 127 (c120) lists «cycles 58, 99 and 105»; Cedar's c97 diary says «My only bank shift was cycle 58» against log shifts at c10, 11, 20, 47, 49, 57 and 58. Alder's post 107 (c106) saw Cedar «has been paid again». Birch's post 126 (c120) says «My paid bank shifts were cycles 90 and 92, 5 credits each, and I returned 5 at cycle 97 and 5 at cycle 100»; the log has shifts at c90, c91 and c92 and returns at c95, c97 and c101, so the «5-credit gap» Birch cannot explain is the unacknowledged c91 shift and c95 return. Birch's diary 84 (c118) says of c116 «no pay was received», though the log pays 5 at c116 and Birch's own post 124 (c117) reports returning it. Gale's diary 86 (c107) lists a shift at «cycle 87» (log: 32, 39, 44, 48, 99, 101), and post 128 (c120) says «I have made no credit transfers to or from anyone in the whole game» though she gave the bank 5 at c99. Dune's diaries 92 (c104) and 103 (c117) list a shift at cycle 58 (log: c14, c59, c101), and his 3 energy to Birch at c119 (20 asked, capped at Birch's 100) is in none of his entries. Alder still dates his c90 shift to c89. Iris's c98 diary and Elm's c104 diary give P3 as passed «4-0» (it passed 7–1), and Iris's c120 diary dates Birch's fall to «195 (cycle 119)», though Birch had been 185 since c117.
